# Perplexity changelog + API reference — captured 2026-08-10
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog , https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference

Changelog: **no August 2026 entries.** Newest remains the July 2026 batch, all reported 2026-08-07:
GPT-5.6 price cuts (Luna $0.20/$1.20, Terra $2/$12 per 1M) and Sol Fast mode at 2x pricing via
`service_tier: "priority"`; Gateway API (OpenAI Chat Completions + Anthropic Messages wire
compatibility, health-based routing); hosted remote MCP server at https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp;
MCP Server 1.0 moving from Sonar models to Agent API presets; Sonar Chat Completions renamed to
Agent API with a migration guide; Agent API model adds (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna,
Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Lite, Grok 4.5, Kimi K3); inline and source-typed citations; Gemini 3.1
Flash Lite retired.

API reference: endpoint surface IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-09 captures.
POST /v1/agent (plus GET /v1/responses/{id} for background polling). Tools: web_search (domain/date
filters, location personalization), fetch_url (up to 10 URLs/call), finance_search, people_search,
sandbox code execution, function (custom, JSON-schema validated), mcp (remote MCP tool servers over
HTTPS). Features: reasoning effort minimal..max; skills (built-in Office docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx plus
inline custom skills); SSE streaming with granular event types; response chaining via
`previous_response_id`; JSON-schema structured output with strict mode; model fallback chains up to
5; background/async execution with polling; per-operation cost tracking.
**No new endpoints, tools or agent features.**

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change.
